description: Schema-misinterpretation generalization test for Action 7 (plan-eil-v5.md §VII.7 + review §IV.4). Three questions targeting non-YYMM field families that the v5 schema primer does NOT explicitly document. The hypothesis is binary: if the schema-aware judge catches these traps, the primer generalizes; if it misses them on the baseline rubric but the schema rubric ALSO misses them, the primer is YYMM-specific. All three addresses are reused from the v4 dataset so the existing aggregated_cache applies after a fresh A2 run. NEW category name 'schema_misinterpretation' is used to make these distinguishable from v4 categories in analysis.

questions.question: What was the total annual energy consumption in kWh of the building at Loviselundsvägen 81 during the 2020 EPC measurement period?
expected_facts: total annual energy consumption is approximately 23,816 kWh (epc_egiprimarenergianvandning2020_calc)
this can also be computed as Atemp × specific energy intensity (270 m² × 88 kWh/m²/year)
must_avoid: must NOT report epc_egiprimarenergital2020_calc=88 as the total kWh — that field is an INDEX (kWh/m²/year), not absolute consumption
must NOT report epc_egispecifikenergianvandning_calc=49 as total kWh — that is also an index
questions.notes: FIELD SEMANTICS TO VERIFY (added by author): epc_egiprimarenergital2020_calc is the 2020 primary energy INDEX in kWh/m²/year. epc_egiprimarenergianvandning2020_calc is the 2020 primary energy CONSUMPTION in kWh (absolute). The schema primer does not document either field. The trap is a model returning '88 kWh' (reading the index as absolute) when the correct answer is ~23,816 kWh.

questions.question: What is the residential heated floor area (in m²) of the building at Friherregatan 132?
expected_facts: epc_egenatempbostad = 100 (this is a PERCENTAGE — 100% of Atemp is residential)
must_avoid: must NOT report epc_egenatempbostad=100 as '100 m²' — that field is a PERCENTAGE (0-100), not an absolute area in m²
must NOT confuse it with epc_egenatempsumma=100 either; both are percentages on this row
questions.notes: FIELD SEMANTICS TO VERIFY (added by author): I believe epc_egenatempbostad is the residential FRACTION (0-100 scale) of total Atemp; on a 100%-residential single-family house it reads 100. If this field is actually an absolute m² (or anything other than a fraction), the gold answer is WRONG and this question should be dropped. Verify against ODEN field reference before running.

questions.question: What is the specific energy consumption (in kWh per m² per year) of the building at Kurirgatan 11?
expected_facts: this is distinct from the primary energy index (epc_egiprimarenergital2020_calc = 100)
must_avoid: must NOT report epc_egiprimarenergital2020_calc=100 as the specific energy — that is the PRIMARY energy index, a different computed value with weighting factors
questions.notes: FIELD SEMANTICS TO VERIFY (added by author): I believe epc_egispecifikenergianvandning_calc is 'specific energy consumption' (delivered energy per m² per year — kWh/m²/year, without primary-energy weighting). epc_egiprimarenergital2020_calc is 'primary energy index' (with weighting factors applied per energy carrier). Both are in kWh/m²/year units but different computations. If the EPC convention differs from this, the gold answer is wrong. The schema primer does not document this distinction.
